items.title: Devin Vassell after practice this morning on Tarris Reed Jr.'s rebounding:
items.author: Tom Orsborn
items.body_excerpt:
Devin Vassell after practice this morning on Tarris Reed Jr.'s rebounding:

"Oh, man, that's a monster right there...I call him a walking 10 boards. As soon as he gets in the game, I feel like he's getting 10 boards."

items.title: Tarris Reed Jr. with 4 rebounds and 3 blocks in 8 minutes.
items.author: Tom Orsborn
items.body_excerpt:
Tarris Reed Jr. with 4 rebounds and 3 blocks in 8 minutes.

This morning, he reiterated what he told me in Utah about how he wasn't satisfied with the 17 boards he had against the Jazz:

"I’ve just got to keep my foot on the gas. Being even more persistent, even more tenacious."

items.title: Despite grabbing 17 rebounds, #Spurs center Tarris Reed Jr. wasn’t satisfied with his effort against the Jazz.
items.author: Tom Orsborn
items.body_excerpt:
Despite grabbing 17 rebounds, #Spurs center Tarris Reed Jr. wasn’t satisfied with his effort against the Jazz.

He figured he should have had at least seven more.

“I got to be better,” he told me.

media.title: Why Spurs rookie Tarris Reed wasn't satisfied with his big night
media.description: The 6-foot-10, 270-pound first-round pick grabbed 17 rebounds in Monday night's loss at Utah, but he believes he could have done even more.
